method.named_view: Private repository names are not published here. A record's handle is sha256('awkronos/' + name) truncated to 12 hex characters, so any member with org read access can resolve a handle by recomputing it from the live repo list.
method.label_view: Runner labels outside the org's published label set are shown as custom:<6hex> so that host-specific names stay off the public surface. The count and the fact that no online runner carries them are unchanged.

self_validation.note: workflow_call is the only trigger, so no run in this repository executes the reusable set when it changes; a caller edits land unvalidated and fail at each caller's next pull request

wave_0_pilot: public host repository callers, one Python product repository, one pnpm product repository, one Lean proof repository
migration.wave_1: every repository in class active-product: replace per-repo install, lint and test steps with the Python or pnpm caller, keep deploy jobs repo-local
migration.wave_2: every repository in class active-math-proof: replace per-repo structural guards with the Lean guard caller, keep proof builds on the org pool label set
migration.wave_3: every repository in class active-infra: single caller plus the release boundary where the surface is public
migration.wave_4: archive candidates: turn the repository read-only, delete its workflow files, drop its runner registrations
migration.acceptance: after each wave, ci_callers_of_org_reusables is nonzero for that wave, ci_self_hosted_files falls to only the jobs that need the pool, registered rows with no file on the default branch stop growing, and no active file asks for a label no online runner carries
